media.prompt: A weathered brass lighthouse on a rocky coast at golden hour, gulls overhead, crashing surf, detailed photograph.

what: Generate an image from a text prompt with the MOSS-Image base checkpoint, which reads a full scene caption and returns one finished image. The prompt upsampler expands a short request into that caption first. Use it for fine-tuning experiments and comparisons with the instruction-tuned checkpoint.

templates_list.name: image_moss_image_base_t2i
templates_list.title: MOSS-Image Base: Text to Image
templates_list.desc: Generate an image from a text prompt with the MOSS-Image base checkpoint, which reads a full scene caption and returns one finished image. The prompt upsampler expands a short request into that caption first. Use it for fine-tuning experiments and comparisons with the instruction-tuned checkpoint.

templates_list.name: image_moss_image_base_t2i_bboxes
templates_list.title: MOSS-Image Base: Layout-Guided Text to Image
templates_list.desc: Generate an image from a text prompt plus a layout drawn in Create Bounding Boxes, using the MOSS-Image base checkpoint. Each box carries its own caption and text boxes render their text. Useful for comparing the base and instruction-tuned checkpoints on the same layout.

templates_list.name: image_moss_image_color_depth_control
templates_list.title: MOSS-Image: Color & Depth Control
templates_list.desc: Re-pose and re-style a reference photo with MOSS-Image: the graph estimates the reference's geometry with MoGe 3, then generates a new image that keeps the pose, framing and silhouette while the prompt decides the character, wardrobe, setting and light. A color/depth control adapter LoRA makes the model follow the estimated map, and the color map socket is there for region-painted layouts.

templates_list.name: image_moss_image_edit
templates_list.title: MOSS-Image: Image Edit LoRA
templates_list.desc: Edit a photo with a short instruction using MOSS-Image and its edit LoRA: the instruction and the source image are encoded together, so the sampler redraws the same frame and only the described change is applied. Colour, material, outfit and background swaps keep the face, hair, pose and framing intact, and a Compare Images node shows the source next to the result.

templates_list.name: image_moss_image_t2i
templates_list.title: MOSS-Image: Text to Image
templates_list.desc: Generate an image from a text prompt with MOSS-Image, an open-weights model that reads a full scene caption and returns one finished image. A prompt upsampler expands a short request into that caption first, so a one-line description is enough. Ideal for editorial photography, product shots, and concept art.

templates_list.name: image_moss_image_t2i_bboxes
templates_list.title: MOSS-Image: Layout-Guided Text to Image
templates_list.desc: Generate an image from a text prompt plus a layout drawn in Create Bounding Boxes. Each box carries its own caption, and text boxes also render their text, so MOSS-Image places every element where you put it. Useful for posters, packaging shots, and any composition where placement matters.

templates_list.name: moss_image_core_t2i
templates_list.title: MOSS Image: Text to Image
templates_list.desc: MOSS Image int8 with stock Qwen3.5 9B int8: er_sde, 25 steps, cfg 2.5.
